notes: The first saying (Zayd ibn Thabit's account of the sale of fruit) reads Layth, Abu al-Zinad, Urwa, Sahl, Zayd; «من بني حارثة» is a tribal attribution, left out
«وأخبرني خارجة بن زيد بن ثابت أن زيد بن ثابت لم يكن يبيع» is a second saying with its own isnad: rule 11, not read as a route here
«قال أبو عبد الله رواه علي بن بحر حدثنا حكام ...» is Bukhari's own remark giving a different full chain for the same saying: a variant group; «كالمشورة يشير بها» is an explanatory gloss, left out
